observation: Code canvas payload mapper in `ReviewCodeDiff` zeroed per-file `added`/`removed` counts and discarded hunks when driven by the canonical `ReviewArtifact` payload, rendering `+0 / -0` for every file and breaking AC-4 until review round one.
Per-canvas tests started as a uniform shallow pattern asserting only title, tool logo, and source link, so relevance ordering, collapsed trivia, CI checks, and diff hunks were not exercised in CI.

Code review required two rounds: round one returned NOT DONE on the payload contract, security href, protectedTests, lint warnings, and payload-cast safety; round two reached DONE only after four follow-up commits.

All six blockers from the first review were resolved: `CodeDiffPayload` now carries stats and hunks, `mapCodeDiffPayload` preserves them, `isSafeSourceHref` guards the browser preview Open link, `protectedTests` is backfilled, new-review lint warnings are cleared, and payload mappers include runtime guards.
TDD red-phase commit `729c636a` preceded implementation, and the strengthened tests after round one now assert L1/L2/L3 structure, relevance ordering, and AC-4 details.

Multi-perspective review caught distinct bug classes in one pass: architecture flagged the payload-contract breach, security flagged the unguarded href, adversarial flagged shallow tests, and design/simplify/AI-slop provided cleanup targets.
`ReviewPage.tsx` and the `/work/bet/:betId/review/:reviewId` route remain as an AL3 composition stub; the `@lore` disclaimer documents the overlap but does not prevent future merge friction.

`ReviewRenderedInContext`, `ReviewMetricsMoved`, and `ReviewBatch` still fall back to local fixture enrichment when the canonical payload is thin, so the production route may show the full design only with fixture-shaped data.
Strengthened tests, runtime payload guards, and source-link guarding landed in follow-up commits; `npm run check` and `npm run lint` are green on the branch.
Five `@lore` comments in `packages/web/src/pages/review/` capture rationale for fixture boundaries, AL2-only integration scaffold, design-token reuse, and hand-built neutral artifact bodies.
